ios.desc:
Explore the World of Music with World Piano

Unlock the rich diversity of global music with World Piano, the ultimate app for exploring the sounds and rhythms of cultures from around the world—all at your fingertips.

"An Essential Tool for Musicians and Music Lovers" - App Store Review

With World Piano, you can experience authentic sound samples from unique instruments like the Sitar, Koto, Duduk, and more. Effortlessly switch between instruments to explore their distinct tones and rhythms.

The app also features a rhythm library where you can play along or import your own beats. Whether you’re sharpening your improvisation skills or simply enjoying the creative process, World Piano is perfect for any musician, from beginner to expert.

Create captivating melodies using an extensive collection of world scales and drones, including those from India, the Middle East, Africa, and Asia—perfect for crafting exotic and inspiring sounds. World Piano even supports microtonal scales for enhanced creativity.

In addition to world instruments, you’ll find a traditional piano mode. Customize octaves, experiment with playing modes, and find the perfect sound for any musical genre.

Download World Piano today and embark on a global musical journey!

Go Premium Unlock the full potential of World Piano by becoming a Premium Member. Access all sound packs with a single subscription:

1 month: $5.99
1 year: $29.99
Note: Prices may vary by country.

These prices are for the US. Pricing in other countries may vary.
• Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase
• Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period
• An account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal
• Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase

Start your worldwide musical journey with World Piano.

Features
• Premium sound and rhythm packs from around the world
• AUv3 and Ableton Link support
• Layer and split sounds for dynamic play
• Save your favorite sounds and rhythms
• Real-time microtonal scale conversion
• Global, Middle Eastern, and Raga scales
• Import Korg KMP, SFZ, WAV, and AIFF files
• MIDI support (control via MIDI keyboard or AudioBus/IAA)
• Comprehensive effects section: Phaser, Tremolo, Chorus, Reverb, and more
• Built-in recording
